# Velyr

Velyr is an AI growth agent that ships one weekly conversion fix as a GitHub Pull Request. Your code, your repo, your approval. €29/month after a 14-day free trial.

> Velyr finds your site's #1 conversion problem each week, writes the code fix as a Pull Request, and waits for your one-tap approval over Telegram. If the change hurts your numbers, it reverts itself within 48 hours.

## What it does
- Every Monday, reads your PostHog analytics (traffic, bounce rate, scroll depth, click behavior) and scans every page in your GitHub repo.
- Identifies the single highest-impact conversion problem across your full funnel — not just the homepage.
- Writes the actual code change and opens a GitHub Pull Request with a Vercel preview link.
- Sends a Telegram message summarizing the problem, the data, and the fix — reply YES to deploy, NO to skip.
- 48 hours after a merge, checks site-wide bounce rate; if it spikes by 15 percentage points or more, it automatically opens a rollback Pull Request.

## How it's different
- It ships real code as Pull Requests, not a dashboard of suggestions you have to implement yourself.
- You approve every change before anything merges — nothing ships silently.
- It has an automatic safety net: a measured rollback if a fix backfires, not just a promise.
- It works inside your existing GitHub + Vercel + PostHog workflow. No new platform to migrate to.

## Who it's for
React, Next.js, or Vite sites deployed on Vercel with a GitHub repository. Indie hackers, solo founders, and small SaaS teams who want continuous conversion optimization without hiring a CRO agency or running it manually.

## Not supported
Shopify, Wix, Squarespace, and Webflow. The agent edits source code, and these site builders don't expose that.

## Pricing
€29/month. 14-day free trial with all features included; a credit card is required to start, and you can cancel anytime during the trial without being charged. Cancel anytime after that too.

## Common questions
- **Do I approve every change?** Yes. Nothing merges without your explicit YES reply, and you see the exact code diff in the Pull Request first.
- **What if a fix makes things worse?** Velyr checks bounce rate 48 hours after each merge and auto-opens a revert PR if it rose by 15 percentage points or more.
- **Does it touch my whole funnel?** Yes — it maps every page in your repo and cross-references your analytics to find where users drop off, then fixes the highest-impact issue.
- **Can I protect certain copy or design?** Yes. Brand Guardrails are written rules the agent must respect; violating suggestions are rejected before they reach you.
- **Is my code safe?** Velyr only proposes changes as Pull Requests on your own GitHub repo. You review and approve before anything merges.
